description: Closed allow-list of files under source/content, source/assets and source/schemas. Engine entries are engine-owned grammars and engine metadata. Pending entries are game data that has not yet moved to its own game folder docs/concepts/<game>/ (Phase 3b removes each one); every other game file lives in a game folder. The TypeScript architecture check rejects unlisted files, stale entries, unknown games and game-shaped engine entries.

engine.reason: Engine-owned JSON Schemas of scenario packs, libraries, balancing, simulation, world, growth, adventure and RTS documents; library.schema.json is the template the build compiles with each game's identity vocabulary.
Engine-owned grammars of asset definitions (definition.schema.json) and 3D asset documents (asset.schema.json).
Engine-owned grammars of creature definitions and the creature catalog configuration.
Engine-owned grammar of creature interaction libraries.
Engine-owned grammar of game folder manifests (game.json).
Engine documentation of the asset definition format that game folders author.
Engine documentation of the creature definition format that game folders author.
Engine audit inventory: maps every balancing gameplay tuner path to the engine source module and expression that consumes it; balancing-audit checks a game's balancing against it.
classic-v1 compatibility reference document (standalone littlewild-actor-rules) used by the rule validators' tests and schema checks; no game profile reads it.
classic-v1 compatibility reference document (standalone littlewild-economy-rules) used by the rule validators' tests and schema checks; no game profile reads it.
classic-v1 compatibility simulation profile validated by the simulation-profile CLI and schema checks; no game profile reads it.
classic-v1 compatibility world profile reference used by developer-toolbox realm tests; no game profile reads it.

pending.reason: Emberworks scenario pack; it still borrows the Littlewild balancing, assets and creatures until Phase 3b materializes docs/concepts/emberworks (decision D4).
Office scenario pack; it still borrows the Littlewild balancing, assets and creatures until Phase 3b materializes docs/concepts/office (decision D4).
RTS Frontier catalog (wildlands-rts); Phase 3b moves it to docs/concepts/rts-frontier as that folder's content.catalog.
Pocket Pet catalog; Phase 3b moves it to docs/concepts/pocket-pet as that folder's content.catalog.
Pocket Pet species and prop definitions (family pets); Phase 3b moves them to docs/concepts/pocket-pet/assets/pets.
